description: A dark-themed terminal UI shows an expanded Tree widget (Dune -> Characters -> Paul, Jessica, Chani) at the top. Below it, inside a scrolling container, one switch is visible and two 'Toggle Button' labels with an 'X' checkbox indicator. An oversized band of empty background separates the switch swatch from the first 'Toggle Button' row, and again between the two 'Toggle Button' rows -- spacing inconsistent with the widgets' real layout, consistent with stale, unrepainted cells left over from a previous scroll position instead of the container's true composition.

The same scrolling container as screenshot 1, after scrolling further. A switch swatch is cut off at the top edge of the scroll view and a second switch swatch sits immediately below it at an irregular offset, followed by two 'Toggle Button' rows. The two switch swatches are stacked with inconsistent vertical spacing rather than a single clean layout, consistent with a switch widget from a prior frame not being fully cleared/repainted when the container scrolled.

A Tree widget shows 'Dune' expanded with its 'Characters' child now collapsed and highlighted (selected, blue background) directly beneath it. Lower in the scrolling container, the stray text fragment 'acters' -- a leftover remnant of the word 'Characters' -- sits inside a highlighted blue box overlapping the top of a switch swatch, next to a 'Toggle Button' row. The duplicated 'acters' text is a stale fragment from the tree's prior frame that was not erased when the tree collapsed and the box below scrolled, leaving old characters printed on top of the new content.
